$comment: Native-speaker review backlog for Arabic translations. Reviewer workflow lives in apps/web/src/locales/README.md. Confidence tags: high = common UI word, safe to ship. medium = domain-specific (finance / OTA terminology), native eyes requested. low = long sentence, legal or compliance nuance, or a term with real ambiguity — MUST be reviewed before the next release.

brand.reason: The Arabic value is also the ordinary word for "invoice" (fātūra). May be intentional branding; equally may confuse a user who sees the chrome word 'invoice' as the app name. Needs a product decision — keep فاتورة, keep the Latin brand Faatora, or coin a transliteration like فاتورا.

nav.languageAriaLabel.reason: Standard screen-reader label; verified against common Arabic UI practice.

accountant.status.suspended.reason: "موقوف" (stopped/frozen) is correct but a reviewer may prefer "مُعلّق" (hung/paused) depending on whether the state is punitive or temporary.

accountant.referred_badge.reason: Unvocalized "محال" is ambiguous — reads as "referred" or "impossible". Reviewer should decide: vocalize as "مُحال" or switch to an unambiguous form like "تمت إحالته" or "إحالة" (as a label).

accountant.mark_referred.en: I referred this client (eligible for revenue share)
accountant.mark_referred.ar: أنا مَن أحال هذا العميل (مؤهّل لحصة الإيرادات)
accountant.mark_referred.reason: Has revenue-share legal implications; must match whatever wording appears in the partner agreement. Reviewer to align with the firm's partner agreement in Arabic.

clients.list.revokeConfirm.en: Revoke this client engagement? Historical data remains, but you will lose cross-tenant access.
clients.list.revokeConfirm.ar: هل تريد إنهاء ارتباط هذا العميل؟ ستبقى بيانات تاريخية، لكن ستفقد الوصول عبر المنشأة.
clients.list.revokeConfirm.reason: Long destructive-action confirmation. Phrase "الوصول عبر المنشأة" is a direct calque; a native reviewer may rephrase as "الوصول إلى بيانات هذه المنشأة".

clients.wizard.batch.errors.tenantName_r.reason: Short domain phrase; reviewer to confirm "منشأة العميل" vs the shorter "اسم المنشأة".

clients.wizard.batch.errors.country_leng.en: Country must be a 2-letter ISO code
clients.wizard.batch.errors.country_leng.ar: يجب أن يكون رمز الدولة من حرفين وفق معيار ISO
clients.wizard.batch.errors.country_leng.reason: A reviewer may prefer "برمز" over "رمز" and may drop the trailing "ISO" if the UI never shows the user the code anyway.

clients.wizard.batch.errors.accessLevel_.ar: مستوى الوصول يجب أن يكون "full" أو "read_only"
clients.wizard.batch.errors.accessLevel_.reason: The quoted tokens are deliberately kept in Latin so the message matches the CSV the user pasted. Reviewer may rephrase the leading clause.

clients.wizard.batch.errors.engagementTy.ar: نوع الارتباط يجب أن يكون "ongoing" أو "periodic"

clients.wizard.batch.errors.shopOwnerEma.en: Shop owner email is not a valid email address
clients.wizard.batch.errors.shopOwnerEma.ar: بريد مالك المنشأة ليس عنواناً إلكترونياً صالحاً
clients.wizard.batch.errors.shopOwnerEma.reason: Double "email" in English; Arabic drops the second mention. Reviewer to confirm.

firms.dashboard.vat_returns.period_range.reason: Standard preposition pair for a date range.

checker.q10_erp.en: Do you use an ERP or accounting system? (optional)
checker.q10_erp.ar: هل تستخدم نظام تخطيط موارد (ERP) أو برنامج محاسبة؟ (اختياري)
checker.q10_erp.reason: Pre-existing. Common fuller form is "نظام تخطيط موارد المؤسسة". Reviewer to decide if the shorter form reads well to an Omani SME.

checker.q5_vatRegistered.en: Is your business registered for VAT in Oman?
checker.q5_vatRegistered.ar: هل منشأتك مسجّلة في ضريبة القيمة المضافة في عُمان؟
checker.q5_vatRegistered.reason: Pre-existing. A reviewer may prefer "مسجّلة لضريبة القيمة المضافة" (registered FOR) over "مسجّلة في" (registered IN).

checker.subtitle.en: Answer 10 quick questions to see how ready your business is for Oman e-invoicing.
checker.subtitle.ar: أجب عن 10 أسئلة قصيرة لمعرفة مدى جاهزية منشأتك للفوترة الإلكترونية في عُمان.
checker.subtitle.reason: Pre-existing long sentence. Phrasing is correct but a native reviewer may tighten it.

firms.bootstrap.subtitle.en: Set up a firm profile so you can start managing client tenants from one place.
firms.bootstrap.subtitle.ar: أنشئ ملف المكتب لتتمكن من إدارة منشآت عملائك من مكان واحد.
firms.bootstrap.subtitle.reason: Pre-existing. Reviewer to confirm "ملف المكتب" vs "صفحة المكتب" or "بروفايل المكتب".

firms.bootstrap.vatin_hint.en: Optional. Add it later from firm settings if you do not have one yet.
firms.bootstrap.vatin_hint.ar: اختياري. يمكنك إضافته لاحقاً من إعدادات المكتب إذا لم يكن لديك واحد الآن.
firms.bootstrap.vatin_hint.reason: Pre-existing. "لديك واحد الآن" is colloquial; reviewer may prefer "إذا لم يكن لديك رقم ضريبي بعد".

ops.validateAll.body.en: Dry-run the compliance pipeline against every DRAFT invoice in every client tenant. Nothing is changed.
ops.validateAll.body.ar: تشغيل تجريبي لمحرّك الامتثال على كل الفواتير بحالة DRAFT لدى كل عميل. لا يتم تغيير أي شيء.
ops.validateAll.body.reason: Pre-existing compliance-engineering copy. "محرّك الامتثال" is a direct calque; may be clearer as "فحوصات الامتثال". The Latin "DRAFT" state token should stay (it's what the API returns) but "بحالة DRAFT" may read oddly.

imports.wizard.subtitle.en: Bring your client's existing books into Faatora from Tally or Zoho Books.
imports.wizard.subtitle.ar: استورد دفاتر عملائك الحالية إلى فاتورة من Tally أو Zoho Books.
imports.wizard.subtitle.reason: Pre-existing. References the brand as "فاتورة" which again depends on the brand-name decision above.

clients.wizard.single.success.en: {{name}} has been added to your firm.
clients.wizard.single.success.reason: Pre-existing. Correct; reviewer to confirm no gender agreement is needed on "تمت".

clients.wizard.single.successHint.en: You can act as this client from the client list.
clients.wizard.single.successHint.ar: يمكنك العمل نيابة عن هذا العميل من قائمة العملاء.
clients.wizard.single.successHint.reason: Pre-existing. "العمل نيابة عن" is a reasonable rendering of "act as" but may be clearer as "الدخول إلى حساب هذا العميل".
